output.as_of: 2025-12-31 (subsidiary list in Exhibit 21 of the FY2025 Form 10-K, the most recent SEC filing that names Whirlpool's subsidiaries; reviewed 2026-11-11)
output.answer: As of December 31, 2025, Whirlpool Corporation's subsidiaries — named in Exhibit 21 of its FY2025 Form 10-K — number roughly 117 entities worldwide. Key operating and holding subsidiaries include the KitchenAid group (KitchenAid, Inc. in Ohio plus KitchenAid units in Australia, France, Germany, Korea, the Netherlands, Sweden, the UK and China), Maytag Sales Inc./Maytag Properties LLC, the InSinkErator group (InSinkErator LLC and units in Australia, Canada, China and the UK), Whirlpool S.A., Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda., Brasmotor Ltda. and B. Blend in Brazil, Industrias/Comercial Acros Whirlpool and Whirlpool Mexico entities, the Whirlpool Global Holdings/EMEA/Asia finance-and-holding chains in Luxembourg, Delaware and the Netherlands, plus entities such as Airdun Limited (UK), Haceb Whirlpool Industrias (Colombia), Whirlpool Bangladesh Limited, Whirlpool South Africa and Xpelair Ltd (UK). Two major units have just left the list: Whirlpool of India Limited was deconsolidated on November 27, 2025, when a Whirlpool Mauritius Limited market sale cut ownership from 51% to about 40% (now a ~40% equity-method investment), and the European major-appliance business was contributed to Beko Europe B.V. on April 1, 2024, where Whirlpool retains a 25% equity interest. The Yummly recipe-app subsidiaries, last listed in the FY2023 10-K, also no longer appear.
caveats: The list is the official roster as of December 31, 2025; SEC interim reports (10-Qs) do not publish a new subsidiary exhibit, so any 2026 additions, closures or name changes after that date would not be reflected. The Q1 2026 10-Q confirms the Whirlpool of India deconsolidation but adds no new list.

Whirlpool's ownership of Whirlpool of India fell to approximately 40% and the company has said it will continue to evaluate options to further reduce debt in 2026 — a further reduction of the India stake (or other divestitures) could change the roster.

The exact number of subsidiaries is derived by counting the rows of Exhibit 21 (the company itself does not state a total), and Exhibit 21 lists legal entities rather than consumer brands — e.g. Maytag, KitchenAid, InSinkErator and Amana appear as branded legal entities, and many rows are holding or financing vehicles with no consumer-facing operations.

Whirlpool of India (~40%-owned, deconsolidated November 27, 2025) and Beko Europe (25%-owned since April 1, 2024) are major equity-method investments, not consolidated subsidiaries, though they remain closely associated with the group under license and services agreements.

passages.quote: On November 27, 2025, the Company's wholly-owned subsidiary, Whirlpool Mauritius Limited ("Seller"), executed the sale of 14.3 million equity shares of Whirlpool India via a market transaction. The transaction reduced Seller's ownership of Whirlpool India from 51% to approximately 40%. The fair value of the retained investment in Whirlpool India at the date of deconsolidation was calculated based on the Whirlpool India stock price (Level 1 input), the portion of interest retained and the shares outstanding, resulting in a fair value of $599 million.

Subsequent to closing of the transaction, the Company holds an equity interest of 25% in Beko. The fair value of the investment in Beko at the date of deconsolidation was calculated based on a discounted cash flow analysis and multiple market data points (Level 3 input), resulting in a fair value of $186 million. The discounted cash flow analysis utilized a discount rate of 15.5%.

Consolidated net sales decreased 9.6% for the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was primarily driven by the deconsolidation of Whirlpool of India, significant industry demand decline in North America and unfavorable price/mix. This was partially offset by favorable currency impacts in Latin America.

passages.quote: In 2024, we completed a market transaction reducing our ownership in Whirlpool of India Ltd ("Whirlpool India") from 75% to 51%. In November 2025 we completed another market transaction to further reduce our ownership in Whirlpool India to approximately 40%. As a result of the transaction, the operations previously reported within MDA Asia segment are no longer reported as a segment. We are pleased with our retained position and will continue to evaluate all options to further reduce our debt throughout 2026 in line with our guidance and capital allocation priorities.

key_facts.fact: Exhibit 21 of Whirlpool's FY2025 Form 10-K names roughly 117 subsidiaries as of December 31, 2025, organized across the US, Brazil, Mexico, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, China, Hong Kong, India, Canada, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, Peru, Ecuador, Uruguay, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Bangladesh, Thailand, Singapore, Taiwan, Australia, New Zealand, the UK, Germany, Italy, Sweden, Poland, Switzerland, South Africa, Bermuda, Mauritius and the UAE.

Major US operating subsidiaries include KitchenAid, Inc. (Ohio), Maytag Sales, Inc. (Delaware), InSinkErator LLC (Delaware), Whirlpool Properties, Inc. (Michigan) and Whirlpool Technologies, LLC (Michigan); major international ones include Whirlpool S.A. and Whirlpool do Brasil Ltda. (Brazil), Industrias Acros Whirlpool (Mexico), Whirlpool Global Holdings (Luxembourg), Whirlpool (China) Investment Co., Ltd. and Whirlpool Asia LLP (India).

Whirlpool of India Limited ceased to be a consolidated subsidiary: on November 27, 2025, wholly-owned subsidiary Whirlpool Mauritius Limited sold 14.3 million shares via a market transaction, cutting ownership from 51% to approximately 40% (retained stake fair value ~$599 million; gross proceeds ~$166 million), deconsolidating Whirlpool India.

Whirlpool's European major domestic appliance business left the subsidiary roster on April 1, 2024 when it was contributed to Beko Europe B.V. in the transaction with Arcelik; Whirlpool holds a 25% equity interest in Beko (fair value at deconsolidation $186 million), and the MENA business was sold as part of the deal.

The Q1 2026 Form 10-Q confirms the deconsolidation of Whirlpool of India was a primary driver of the 9.6% year-over-year net sales decline for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 — i.e., the India unit is no longer a subsidiary as of the company's most recent filing.

The Yummly, Inc. (Delaware) and Yummly Canada Ltd. (British Columbia) subsidiaries, last listed in the FY2023 Form 10-K Exhibit 21, no longer appear in the FY2025 list — the recipe-app business was divested between those filings.

Whirlpool's other principal non-subsidiary equity-method investments as of year-end 2025 are partial ownership in Whirlpool China, Beko Europe B.V. and Whirlpool India, all previously controlled and now accounted for under the equity method.
